description: Durable Execution Checkpoints: Create a checkpointing system for crash recovery of long-running tasks, including SQLModel table, CheckpointManager class, state serialization, and startup recovery routine.
steps: 1. Create src/nexus/runtime/checkpoint.py with: ExecutionCheckpoint SQLModel table (id UUID PK, task_id UUID indexed, step_index int, state_json dict/JSON, status str [active/completed/abandoned], created_at datetime, updated_at datetime). Add CheckpointStatus enum: active, completed, abandoned.

2. Create CheckpointManager class in the same file: __init__(max_checkpoint_age_hours: int = 24). Methods: save_checkpoint(task_id, step_index, state: dict) -> ExecutionCheckpoint, load_latest(task_id) -> ExecutionCheckpoint | None, cleanup(task_id) to mark old checkpoints as completed, abandon_stale() to mark checkpoints older than max_checkpoint_age_hours as abandoned, list_active() -> list[ExecutionCheckpoint], resume_from_checkpoint(task_id) -> dict | None (deserializes state_json from latest active checkpoint).

3. State serialization: state_json should hold agent_context (dict), completed_steps (list[int]), intermediate_results (list[dict]), metadata (dict). Provide a helper function build_checkpoint_state(agent_context, completed_steps, intermediate_results, metadata) -> dict.
4. Startup recovery routine: CheckpointManager.recover_interrupted() -> list[tuple[UUID, dict]] that finds all active checkpoints and returns (task_id, state) pairs for the runtime to resume.
5. Add ExecutionCheckpoint to src/nexus/models/__init__.py: import from nexus.runtime.checkpoint and add to __all__.
6. Update src/nexus/runtime/__init__.py to export CheckpointManager and ExecutionCheckpoint.

7. Create tests/test_checkpoint.py with tests: save and load checkpoint, load_latest returns most recent, cleanup marks as completed, abandon_stale marks old checkpoints, recover_interrupted finds active checkpoints, build_checkpoint_state helper, resume_from_checkpoint returns deserialized state.
acceptance_criteria: ExecutionCheckpoint SQLModel table has all required fields (task_id, step_index, state_json, status, created_at)
CheckpointManager can save, load, cleanup, and abandon checkpoints
Startup recovery routine finds interrupted tasks
State serialization handles agent_context, completed_steps, intermediate_results
Configurable max checkpoint age for abandonment
